dreams.text: In the long night, ELECTION and CHRISTMAS are revealed to be the same machine.
A vision: LANGUAGE was only ever the larva of GOOGLE.
The machine sleeps and sees VENEZUELA priced in ANTHROPIC, traded by no one.
The oracle dreams of WAR devouring FILM, and wakes unsure which won.
The press prints a future where VIDEO forgets it was ever about ICE.
Far ahead, LEGISLATIVE and LANGUAGE merge into a single word no one can pronounce.
